title: Sprint 5 — Schema Validation, Transactions & Security
description: Production-grade MongoDB — enforce data quality, atomic multi-document operations, and access control.

tickets.title: Ticket 1 — Schema Validation
tickets.description:
Create a collection with JSON schema validation.
Handle validation errors and validationAction.
Add validation to existing collections.

tasks.title: Task 5.1.1 — Create a Collection with JSON Schema Validation
tasks.description: Enforce data integrity by defining rules for the structure and types of fields in a collection.

tasks.title: Task 5.1.2 — Validation Error Handling & validationAction
tasks.description: Manage how MongoDB responds when documents fail validation rules.

tasks.title: Task 5.1.3 — Adding Validation to Existing Collections
tasks.description: Apply schema validation to collections that already contain data and handle existing non-compliant documents.

tickets.title: Ticket 2 — Transactions
tickets.description:
Compare single-document atomicity vs multi-document.
Run multi-document transactions with commit.
Run multi-document transactions with rollback.

tasks.title: Task 5.2.1 — Single-Document Atomicity vs Multi-Document
tasks.description: Understand the difference between atomic operations on a single document and transactions across multiple documents.

tasks.title: Task 5.2.2 — Multi-Document Transactions (Commit)
tasks.description: Execute multiple operations across different documents and collections as a single, all-or-nothing transaction.

tasks.title: Task 5.2.3 — Multi-Document Transactions (Rollback)
tasks.description: Handle errors and safely abort a multi-document transaction to ensure data consistency.

tickets.title: Ticket 3 — Security & Access Control
tickets.description:
Create users and roles.
Verify role-based access.
Create custom roles and privilege grants.

tasks.title: Task 5.3.1 — Create Users & Roles
tasks.description: Secure your database by creating user accounts and assigning them predefined roles.

tasks.title: Task 5.3.2 — Role-Based Access Verification
tasks.description: Verify that users only have access to the data and operations permitted by their assigned roles.

tasks.title: Task 5.3.3 — Custom Roles & Privilege Grants
tasks.description: Create granular, custom access controls by defining specific privileges for users.
